enunciado: Represent an undirected graph with 7 vertices and edges 0-1, 0-2, 1-3, 2-3, 3-4, 4-5 in an adjacency matrix. Show the matrix, each vertex's degree, the neighbors of vertex 3 and the number of edges.
objetivos: Represent a graph with a matrix
pistas: adj[i][j] == 1 if the edge i-j exists.
The degree of i is the sum of row i.
The sum of all degrees is twice the number of edges.
